components.html: COMP2711 / Counting

narrative.overview: A paper-colored reading notebook that inherits the existing Logic site. Muted blue identifies links, actions and reading controls; Georgia-led prose sits beneath compact system-sans headings. The design serves sustained reading, with restrained borders and generous separation between source pages. The COMP2711 brand spans a course → Counting module → L2.5 chapter → topic lesson hierarchy. Full-width module and chapter entry rows reuse the same restrained rules and blue actions; chapter topic cards retain the existing reading layout.
keyCharacteristics: COMP2711 → Counting → L2.5 → 8 topic lessons, with stable lesson URLs and existing progress.
Read mode: complete explanations first, practice after each topic.
Warm paper, blue emphasis and softly rounded reading surfaces.
Local assets, local progress and direct file opening.
dos: Do preserve the Logic palette and Georgia/system-sans pairing.
Do keep complete explanations readable within the 74ch text measure.
Do keep original pages and answers available through native disclosure controls.
Do preserve keyboard focus, responsive wrapping and local asset paths.
donts: Don't replace the reading layout with a dashboard or day-based organization.
Don't require downloaded fonts, remote math rendering or network access.
Don't rewrite saved explanations as a visual-design change.
